notes.title: Zumbido Seele ReZumbido Seele Update
notes.notes:
Seele Buzz Update Update with a completely revamped game system/version, reworked or changed mechanics, changes and improvements to: 
• Enemy Physics 
• Environment Object Physics 
• Added missing sounds such as the weapon reload sound 
• Widget/Hud Improvements 
• Inventory Changed to the "Q" key 
• Barrel Grabbing and Dropping 
• New Enemy Faces 
• Randomized Weather 
• Dynamic Weather 
• Dodge System 
• Graphics 
• Optimization 
• Gore System 
• Unreal 5.6 Performance 
• Ray Tracing 
• Lumen 
• Reworked some enemies 
• Added, improved, or changed map aesthetics 
• Fixed the constant and unacceptable unexpected crash error from the previous Seele Buzz version when playing on any map.

notes.title: New map "Room 13"
notes.notes: New map, "Room 13," tweaks to gameplay rhythms, and an update to the "Toomb Valley" map.

notes.title: Zumbido Seele Update
notes.notes:
• 4 new maps added, bringing the total to 7 maps 
• Dismemberment/Gore systems 
• 3 characters added 
• Some extra sfx added
• Weapons added and some design changes

notes.title: displacement mechanics
notes.notes:
displacement mechanics:
.
Added dodge, climb and hook mechanics, these mechanics add dynamism to the gameplay

notes.title: Various appearance and mechanical updates
notes.notes:
Various appearance and mechanical updates
.
Weapons: The following weapons were added: "Milia Exir Pistol", the "Emiliunter" automatic pistol and the "Heleniaber gold" rifle.
In addition to this, the name of the main gun has been changed to "Everlaya" and the common rifle to "Heleniaber" rifle. Adjustments have also been made to the damage and firing rate of some weapons.
.
Shop: Previously mentioned weapons from this update now available in the shop
.
Enemies: Adjustments to enemy variations and adjustments to their health and damage and dog enemies added
.
Mechanics: Enemies when they die have a chance of throwing money, weapons or health, so the automatic money reward when killing an enemy was eliminated, a mechanic with which you will have to go grab the money they throw when they die
.
Maps: Slight changes and additions to the textures and appearance of the levels
